input.quote: 19.2 For ninety days after delivery or acceptance, whichever is later, each Deliverable will materially conform to its documentation and acceptance criteria. Hosted Services will conform throughout the subscription term.
input.rationale: Section 19 meets the preferred position on every material term: 19.1 warrants Services performed in a professional and workmanlike manner by qualified personnel to industry standards, plus material conformance of Services and Deliverables to documentation and specifications; 19.2 gives a ninety (90) day (i.e. 90 days / 3 months) Deliverable conformance warranty running from the later of delivery or acceptance, and warrants Hosted Services will conform throughout the subscription term (exceeding the 12-month software benchmark for a hosted product); 19.3 adds no intentionally introduced malicious code, Applicable Law compliance, no functionality diminishment and no contaminating open source; 19.4 supplies re-performance, repair or replacement at no charge escalating to termination and refund of Fees paid, expressly non-exclusive for fraud, infringement, confidentiality, privacy, security and indemnified claims. The 19.5 disclaimer is mutual, limited to implied warranties, and expressly does not limit any express warranty, service level, indemnity or remedy, so it does not swallow the express warranty and the "AS IS" walk-away is not implicated. Section 6 acceptance does not truncate the period (it runs from the later of delivery or acceptance, and 6.2 adds an independent correction/termination/refund path); Section 3.1 reinforces the performance standard. The warranty period is therefore at least 90 days on substance. The only shortfall was drafting form: 19.2 spells the period out as "ninety days" with no numeral, which left the duration ambiguous on its face and failed the period check. The attached edit is a non-substantive clarification inserting "(90)" so the period reads "ninety (90) days"; it changes no commercial term, adds no obligation on Vendor beyond what 19.2 already provides, and can be dropped if Vendor prefers the words-only form.

proposal.summary: State the Deliverable warranty period as "ninety (90) days" so the 90-day period is unambiguous on its face.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We are content with the substance of Section 19 and have not changed the bargain; we have only added the numeral so the warranty period reads "ninety (90) days", consistent with how the other periods are cited in this Agreement, to avoid any later argument about the duration.

ops.oldText: For ninety days after delivery or acceptance
ops.newText: For ninety (90) days after delivery or acceptance
